title: Stardew Valley
shortDescription: A gentle farming and community simulation that turns daily routines, relationships, and long-term projects into a welcoming rhythm.
highlights: Flexible days support different definitions of progress
A detailed community gives routine tasks an authored sense of place

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A strong PC simulation baseline because its systems are approachable in short sessions but deep enough to support long-running personal projects.
